note: A PINNED OFFLINE SNAPSHOT of the grype vulnerability DB, not a live CVE feed. Every scan runs --network none against this snapshot; a CVE published after snapshot_date is invisible to it, and rescanning shipped artifacts against a newer snapshot is an operator leg (plan §6). The DB itself is ~2GB and is NOT committed: hydrate it with `scripts/release/sbom.sh --hydrate-db` into $PALAI_VULN_DB_DIR (default dist/vulndb).
